rationaleSummary: Pin mateuszsury/uZigbee ZBOSS/v1.6 stack as MicroPython+native Zigbee PoC. Do not mix with ESP Zigbee SDK v2 / esp-zigbee-lib ~2.0.0 used by interim firmware/esp32c6-zigbee-coordinator/. Full v2 API port deferred (genuine rewrite required).

toolchain.idfInstallHint: git clone --recursive https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf.git && cd esp-idf && git checkout v5.3.2 && ./install.sh esp32c6 && . ./export.sh

incompatibleWith.reason: Espressif v2.x replaced ZBOSS; headers/libs/API are not ABI-compatible with v1.6 uZigbee. Official migration: https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-zigbee-sdk/en/latest/esp32c6/migration-guide/v2.x/overview.html

rejectedAlternatives.whyNot: Requires rewriting the entire native C bridge from esp_zb_* (ZBOSS) to ezb_* / esp-zigbee-lib 2.x APIs — not a drop-in pin bump.
Interim host-controlled ESP-IDF target has no MicroPython _uzigbee module; mixing v1 headers with v2 libs is undefined.
